exposure: vaginal delivery vs caesarean section for preterm breech twins
vaginal delivery vs caesarean section for preterm breech singletons
outcome: transfer rate to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Preterm breech infants delivered between 24-37 gestational weeks over 10 years from 1/2000 to 12/2009 at the University Clinic of Salzburg, Austria
finding: These data do not support a policy of routine caesarean section for improved fetal outcome of preterm breech infants.
mod_finding: This study compared outcomes for preterm breech infants delivered vaginally or by cesarean section, finding that while vaginal delivery was associated with lower cord blood pH, there was not enough evidence to support routine cesarean delivery for all preterm breech infants.
